observations.what: Function _candidate_paths is incomplete for Go, PHP, C#, Python, QML, etc.; only handles c/cpp, js/ts, java/kotlin, rust.
Rust import parsing in _parse_import: strips leading 'use', splits on '::{' or '::*', takes first segment; kind is internal if first segment is 'crate', 'self', 'super' else external.
For Java/Kotlin, _parse_import returns the package path without trailing .*; always marks as internal.
For Go, _parse_import returns all string literals as internal imports; no external detection.
